about_the_game:
​​Grand cosmic megastructures and ceaseless interstellar fleets conceal the dark underbelly of civilization. Behind the radiance, countless obscure "gray corners" bear the truth of how the civilization truly operates. As a corporate investigator hustling for the company, you will confront these unspeakable deals and covert missions. Field operations are perilous—you must deal with all manner of factions and figures, employing every means to secure benefits for yourself and the company.​

In this universe, starship clashes are commonplace, and an art form. Before each mission, you can customize your fleet configuration: ship classes, core modules, weapon loadouts, and formation arrangements. Every choice is a matter of life and death.

The game features real-time strategic combat. You may choose auto-battle, letting the system intelligently control your fleet for optimal efficiency, or take direct command—manually controlling each starship to focus fire, maneuver, or execute precision strikes. Whether you prefer hands-off delegation or seizing control of pivotal battles, the choice is yours.

As you delve deeper, you'll unlock additional ship classes, combat modules, and system synergies, assembling a galactic fleet that reflects your unique tactical style.

Each mission is a self-contained, roguelike adventure with randomized events and battles. The company's core objective is profit—and the rare items obtained during field operations often exceed the value of your fleet itself. Resource allocation is key to survival in this shadowy corner. Missions can be aborted at any time to cut losses—failure is not shameful, but bankruptcy is fatal.

 

Back at the space station, you can pay to repair ships, purchase new modules, expand your fleet, enhance your firepower, or simply take a break before the next assignment.

During missions, you'll encounter bizarre and absurd events, experiencing storylines that blur the line between comedy and tragedy. This black humor isn't just satire—it's a window into the daily reality of the galaxy's unseen underbelly.

When a mission ends, you can return to the station and share a drink with fellow down-and-out spacers, trading anecdotes of fieldwork's strangest encounters. After all, misery loves company—why not chat awhile?

content_descriptors.notes: Pain caused by common space diseases and drugs used to treat them. Psychological problems caused by social pressure and common means of counseling. Financial related illegal acts and their legal consequences. These topics are addressed in the story, but not directly in the gameplay.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10+ (32/64 bits)
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU, 1 GB VRAM/ AMD HD5750 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Minimal resolution: 1280*720
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10+ (32/64 bits)
  • Processor: Core i3 2,5 GHz or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU, 2 GB VRAM / GTX 750ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Recommended resolution: 1920x1080

short_description: Nonentity Galaxy is a strategy game featuring starship combat, roguelike gameplay, and dark humor. You will play as a corporate investigator dealing with various factions and figures, upholding company interests while scraping together a chance to survive… or perhaps, a shred of dignity.
